title: Clinical3D-Bench: Evaluating and Improving Spatial Intelligence of Multimodal LLMs in Hospital Environments
abstract: arXiv:2611.32094v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spatial reasoning in hospitals requires tracking look-alike equipment, interpreting patient-relative directions, and judging passage widths, yet existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of these abilities. We introduce Clinical3D-Bench, a simulated benchmark with 3,368 questions of eight types on egocentric walkthroughs of 373 hospital-room layouts. Layouts follow hospital design guidelines, answers are computed from the 3D scenes, and paired scene states test whether models change their answers when relevant evidence changes. Videos are photorealistic, and ten physicians screened the layouts. Among 35 multimodal large language models (MLLMs), the best open and proprietary models reach 45.7% and 53.6% macro accuracy, against 40.8% for an answer prior and 79.0% for physicians on a subset, and 27 of 32 open models score below 40% on two-way patient-relative directions. translated_title: Clinical3D-Bench：评估并提升多模态大语言模型在医院环境中的空间智能
translated_abstract: 医院中的空间推理需要追踪外观相似的设备、解读相对于患者的方向，以及判断通道宽度，但现有基准对这些能力的覆盖有限。我们提出 Clinical3D-Bench，这是一个模拟基准，包含针对 373 种病房布局第一人称视角漫步视频的 3,368 个八类问题。布局遵循医院设计指南，答案由 3D 场景计算得出，成对的场景状态用于检验模型在相关证据发生变化时是否会改变其答案。视频具有照片级真实感，并由十位医生对布局进行审核。在 35 个多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中，最优的开源模型和专有模型分别达到 45.7% 和 53.6% 的宏平均准确率，而答案先验为 40.8%，医生在一个子集上达到 79.0%；32 个开源模型中有 27 个在双向患者相对方向任务上得分低于 40%。在我们包含 44,750 个问题的训练集 Clinical3D-45K 上进行微调……
tldr: 提出 Clinical3D-Bench 医院 3D 空间推理基准，揭示当前多模态大模型的空间推理能力远逊于医生，并通过 Clinical3D-45K 数据集微调显著提升了模型的空间智能。
